title: Software taps and scattered multi-generation references
summary: This topic is dominated by scattered uses of words like several, generations, trips, and support, with the clearest concrete theme being complaints about sluggish software and multi-tap screen interactions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe sluggish software and display interactions that require several taps or screens, making functions harder to use while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention vehicle generations, trips with several waypoints, repeated contact with technical support, and comparisons with earlier generations without enough context to infer sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects rather than one coherent issue.
Most fragments are too short or incomplete to determine sentiment beyond the two clear software-usability complaints.
The sampled examples are stratified and not representative of overall prevalence or defect rates.
